title: mri_glmfit-sim
description: A tool to run corrections for multiple comparisons on volumes or surfaces, using various methods including Monte Carlo simulation, permutation, and Gaussian Random Fields.

mczsim.description: Use pre-computed z-based Monte Carlo simulations. Requires vwthreshold and sign.
mczsim.title: Monte Carlo Simulations

mczsim_dir.description: Directory for custom Monte Carlo simulations, default is FREESURFER_HOME/average/mult-comp-cor.
mczsim_dir.title: Monte Carlo Simulations Directory

mczsim_label.description: Label for custom Monte Carlo simulations, default is cortex.
mczsim_label.title: Monte Carlo Simulations Label

perm.description: Use permutation simulation with nsim iterations, cluster forming threshold (CFT), and sign.
perm.title: Permutation Simulation

perm_resid.description: Use permutation on the residual instead of raw data for non-orthogonal designs.
perm_resid.title: Permutation on Residual

perm_signflip.description: Use sign flipping instead of shuffling for permutation.
perm_signflip.title: Permutation Sign Flipping

grf.description: Use Gaussian Random Fields (GRF) method, with vwthreshold and sign.
grf.title: Gaussian Random Fields

spaces_2.description: Apply additional Bonferroni correction across 2 spaces.
spaces_2.title: Correction for 2 Spaces

spaces_3.description: Apply additional Bonferroni correction across 3 spaces.
spaces_3.title: Correction for 3 Spaces

bg.description: Divide simulation into njobs and put in background.
bg.title: Background Jobs

sleep.description: Number of seconds to sleep between background polls.
sleep.title: Sleep Duration

a2009s.description: Use aparc.a2009s instead of aparc for region of vertex max.
a2009s.title: Use a2009s Annotation

annot.description: Use specific annotation for region of vertex max.
annot.title: Annotation

no_sim.description: Do not simulate, only run cluster.
no_sim.title: No Simulation

seed.description: Set simulation random number generator seed.
seed.title: Simulation Seed

fwhm_add.description: Add fwhmAdd to the estimated fwhm.
fwhm_add.title: FWHM Add

uniform.description: Use uniform PDF instead of gaussian, specify min and max.
uniform.title: Uniform PDF

no_out_annot.description: Do not output a cluster annotation.
no_out_annot.title: No Output Annotation

no_cluster_mean.description: Do not compute means of each subject in each cluster.
no_cluster_mean.title: No Cluster Mean

y_file.description: Specify the GLM input y file.
y_file.title: GLM Input Y File

centroid.description: Report the coordinates/annotation of the centroid instead of max.
centroid.title: Centroid Reporting

spatial_sum.description: Compute the sum over voxels in the cluster rather than the average.
spatial_sum.title: Spatial Sum

help.description: Show the help message and exit.
help.title: Help
